newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against the dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7600/7700 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday as reopening of international markets triggered heavy demand for the U.S. currency from importers, dealers said.
The rate compared with the previous close of 43.7500/7550.
The local unit opened weaker at 43.7500/7800 per dollar but avoided a further slump, helped by high call money rates.
Call money was traded between 12 to 14 percent, marginally down from the previous 13-15 percent.
